headline: Command Room now works with whatever mail and calendar you connect — and you can tell it which email accounts are business and which are personal.

items.prompt_template: Command Room no longer assumes Gmail. It now resolves whatever mail and calendar connectors you actually have — Outlook, Superhuman, Google, or something newer — and picks the right tools automatically. Nothing to configure; if your setup worked yesterday, it works the same today.

You can now tell Command Room what each connected email account is for. Say '[address] is my personal account' and that account's mail stays out of your business records permanently — important personal items can still show in your brief without ever being filed. Say 'what accounts do I have' to see the map. Until you classify an account, nothing changes.
